description: This file implements a lockfile management module for handling file-based locks, including acquiring, releasing, and updating locks with support for stale lock detection and retries. It uses Node.js modules such as 'path', 'fs', 'retry', and 'signal-exit'.

methods.name: probe
methods.description: Checks and caches the precision of file modification times.

methods.name: getMtime
methods.description: Returns a Date object representing the current time with precision based on input.

methods.name: getLockFile
methods.description: Generates the lockfile path based on input file and options.

methods.name: resolveCanonicalPath
methods.description: Resolves the canonical path of a file, optionally resolving symlinks.

methods.name: acquireLock
methods.description: Attempts to create a lock by making a directory; handles stale lock detection.

methods.name: isLockStale
methods.description: Determines if a lock is stale based on its modification time.

methods.name: removeLock
methods.description: Removes a lock directory, ignoring errors if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: updateLock
methods.description: Periodically updates the lock's mtime to keep it active.

methods.name: setLockAsCompromised
methods.description: Marks a lock as compromised and triggers callback.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Main function to acquire a lock on a file with retries and options.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Releases a lock on a file.

methods.name: ensureCleanup
methods.description: Sets up cleanup to release locks on process exit.
